in_hebrew.name: קתרין
in_hebrew.meaning: טוהר וקדושה, שמו של מקום בקרייתים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם קתרין מקורו בשם העברי קתרינה, הנגזר מהמילה 'קתרוס' שפירושה טוהר. בקרייתים, מקום המוזכר בתנ"ך, היה קתרין שמו של מקום. השם מתאר את הטוהר והקדושה הנדרשים מחסידי האל.

in_greek.name: Καθρίνη
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Καθρίνη προέρχεται από το ελληνικό όνομα Αικατερίνη, που σημαίνει 'καθαρή'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, η Αγία Αικατερίνη αναφέρεται ως μία από τις σημαντικότερες αγίες της Εκκλησίας. Το όνομα Καθρίνη συμβολίζει την πνευματική καθαρότητα και την αγιότητα που επιδιώκουν οι Χριστιανοί.

in_latin.name: Catharina
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Catharina originem habet in hebraico nomine Katherina, quod significat 'puritas'. In Ecclesia primitiva, Catharinae nomen erat symbolum sanctitatis et purificationis spiritualis. Christiani medio aevo hoc nomen elegerunt ad exprimendam devotionem suam ad Deum.

in_english.name: Kathryn
in_english.long_meaning: The name Kathryn originates from the Hebrew name Katherina, meaning 'pure'. It was popularized through the Greek name Aikaterine, also meaning 'pure'. In Christian tradition, Kathryn symbolizes spiritual purity, clarity, and holiness. Historically, the name has been associated with Saint Catherine, an early Christian martyr and scholar. Today, Kathryn remains a popular name across Christian cultures, signifying a connection to faith and moral integrity.

data.spiritual_significance: Kathryn carries a deep spiritual significance as a symbol of purity, faith, and strength. In Christianity, the name represents the unwavering faith of the saints, with Kathryn of Alexandria being a prime example. Known for her courage and wisdom, she refused to renounce her faith in front of the pagan Emperor Maxentius, leading to her execution. Her unwavering faith and commitment to Christianity have made her an inspiration for generations. The name Kathryn continues to be a reminder of the strength and purity of the faith, inspiring those who bear the name to live a virtuous and holy life.
